thesis: The single most valuable conversion mechanism on this site is the homepage's ability to establish trust and reduce purchase risk for first-time visitors, but it is bleeding value because the homepage shows no trust signals above the fold—no returns policy, guarantee, reviews, or security badge—leaving visitors with nothing to offset their risk.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.summary: All six standard security headers are absent, weakening protection against XSS, clickjacking, and downgrade attacks, which can undermine user trust.
findings.problem: All six standard security headers are absent, weakening protection against XSS, clickjacking, and downgrade attacks, which can undermine user trust.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add the missing headers at the CDN or web-server layer; HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are one-line changes.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live origin: missing HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing trust signals above the fold
findings.summary: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, or security badge, so first-time visitors have nothing to offset purchase risk, hurting trust and conversions.
findings.problem: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, or security badge, so first-time visitors have nothing to offset purchase risk, hurting trust and conversions.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Surface review counts, the returns window and a guarantee near the primary call to action.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: no match for returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Weak page metadata
findings.summary: Search and social previews are degraded because page titles, meta descriptions, and Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths, reducing organic traffic.
findings.problem: Search and social previews are degraded because page titles, meta descriptions, and Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths, reducing organic traffic.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Write a 15-60 char title and 70-160 char description per page; add og:title and og:image for link previews.
findings.evidence: Measured on the homepage: title 0 chars (15-60 recommended); description 0 chars (70-160 recommended); og:title missing, og:image missing.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: No responsive viewport declared
findings.summary: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small and severely hurting mobile usability and conversions.
findings.problem: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small and severely hurting mobile usability and conversions.
findings.evidence: Measured on the mobile render: no <meta name="viewport"> present.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift
